answer: Flooding registration pushes an adversary to the back of the crystal queue while genuine members promoted earlier goes on earning. Admission is quota-limited: at most 237 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the wharf. The vine index is deterministic from ledger replay, which means nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A farm of 131 pays that 44 times. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
